description: Very quiet summer afternoon in forest and dune area. Play at low volume for good playback (it was very quiet here). There is a light constant breeze you can hear. There are some little birds in the forest. Birds detected with BirdNet app in orginal long 42 minute recording: Erasian Blue Tit, Short-toet Treecreeper, European robin, Eurasian Nuthatch, Common Redstart. I think this forest and dune area is the quietest part of this busy province.
